dedupe_keys.name: typical extreme meteorological year and heatwaves for dynamic building simulations in belgium based on mar model simulations

description: Researchers at the University of Liège publish weather files for dynamic building simulations in twelve Belgian cities. Version 1.0 contains typical meteorological years, extreme meteorological years and heatwave events derived from the regional MAR model. The historical simulations use ERA5 forcing for 1980–2020. Further runs use BCC-CSM2-MR, MPI-ESM1.2 and MIROC6 climate-model forcing over 1980–2100. Zenodo lists a separate ZIP archive for each city, including Brussels, Antwerp, Liège and Ostend. The record is openly accessible and licensed CC-BY-4.0, so reuse is free with attribution. Internal file formats and sampling intervals were not confirmed from the repository metadata. The twelve-city release should not be interpreted as a continuous national weather grid, and representative years do not preserve every event in a full multi-decade sequence. Building modellers could use the files to compare heating, cooling and overheating responses to typical and extreme conditions. They complement data-climate-onebuilding-tmyx-weather-files with MAR-derived Belgian climate scenarios.
